title: Kimi native management
ownership: The Kimi installation and native data are owned by your system. Removing this Cognia agent does not uninstall Kimi or erase its history.
terminalPolicy: Native tools run in a visible terminal under your terminal settings. They are separate from the Cognia ACP agent session. Recipes use POSIX shell syntax; only KIMI_CODE_HOME is carried over, never model keys or ACP launch arguments.

notes.install: Node.js and npm required. This installs the reviewed 2.1.1 package; reconnect Cognia after installation.
notes.restore: Reinstalls version 2.1.1 with npm. This is a package-manager restore, not a Cognia receipt-based rollback. For another installation method, use its original installer.
notes.uninstall: Use only if Kimi was installed globally with npm. Native account state and session data are retained. Disconnect running Kimi sessions before uninstalling.
notes.doctor: Validates config.toml and tui.toml without changing them or calling a model.
notes.native: Run /plugins to install, enable, disable, reload or remove native plugins; /usage for subscription usage; /goal, /swarm and /undo for native workflows. Plugin management, Goal, Swarm and Undo are not supported by Kimi ACP; ACP /usage reports session tokens only. Native Skills, agents and hooks use Kimi configuration.
notes.web: Starts the official local web UI with default loopback binding and bearer authentication. Manage plugins and account usage there. Keep the terminal open; Ctrl-C stops the server. This is a separate native session surface.
notes.migrate: Opens the official interactive migration. Review the native prompts before changing legacy data.
notes.upgrade: Checks for the newest official version and prompts before installation. Cognia currently accepts >=2.1.1 and <3.0.0; a newer version may require a compatibility review. Reconnect after updating, or restore 2.1.1 if needed.

failed: Could not copy or open the native command. Check the configuration and terminal availability.
exportNote: Exports an explicit native session as ZIP, excluding the global log that may contain other projects. Run the command in this agent’s working directory.
quota: ACP provides context and session token usage, not subscription quota. The official native /usage UI and Server API GET /api/v1/oauth/usage provide account quota windows and resets. Cognia does not read OAuth secrets to fetch them.
extensions: Skills can be discovered by Kimi in new sessions. Installing or changing native plugins, agents and hooks may require native reload or a new Cognia session; existing turns are not automatically reconfigured.
localTerminalRequired: Direct launch requires a local macOS/Linux desktop terminal. On other hosts, copy the POSIX recipe or follow the official platform instructions.
confirmDescription: This changes the shared system-owned Kimi package in a visible terminal and can affect every configuration using that installation. Review the exact command below. The terminal may request additional installation confirmation; opening it does not confirm installation success.
disconnectForPackage: Disconnect all Kimi agents before changing the shared system package; wait for any connecting or reconnecting agents to stop.
